chunks: Sufficient is Allah as a Disposer of affairs.
And eat of what Allah has provided for you as lawful and good.
And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.
ai.seo_question: What are the key Quranic verses cited in Hadith 57 of Kamal al-Din regarding sustenance and piety?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Kamal al-Din*, this hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on *al-kifayah* (divine sufficiency) as a spiritual state for the faithful, linking material provision with moral integrity. It highlights that lawful sustenance (*halal rizq*) is not merely a physical necessity but a means to attain closeness to Allah, reinforcing the eschatological accountability central to Shia theology.
